definitions.explanation: The maximum possible score on a test or evaluation.
Figuratively, something that is perfect or ideal in every way.

examples.japanese: ⟦テスト→テスト：01065_tesuto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{満点|まんてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}った→取る：00565_toru⟧。
examples.english: I got a perfect score on the test.

examples.japanese: ⟦{百点|ひゃくてん}→百点：26343_hyakuten⟧{満点|まんてん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{九十八|きゅうじゅうはち}→九十八：noentry⟧⟦{点|てん}→点：01553_ten⟧⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧。
⟦{数学|すうがく}→数学：01442_suugaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦テスト→テスト：01065_tesuto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{満点|まんてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}るのは→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧。
examples.english: It's hard to get a perfect score on a math test.

examples.japanese: {満点|まんてん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{笑顔|えがお}→笑顔：01884_egao⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦お{弁当|べんとう}→お弁当：02864_obentou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{満点|まんてん}⟦だね→だ：09496_da⟧。
⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{見|み}た{目|め}→見た目：14110_mitame⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{満点|まんてん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: It was a dish that was perfect in both taste and appearance.

notes:
{満点|まんてん} combines {満|まん} (full) + ⟦{点|てん}→点：01553_ten⟧ (points). It means both a literal perfect score and figuratively anything perfect or flawless.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {満点|まんてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧: to get a perfect score
- ⟦{百点|ひゃくてん}→百点：26343_hyakuten⟧{満点|まんてん}: out of 100 points (used to specify the scale)
- {満点|まんてん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{笑顔|えがお}→笑顔：01884_egao⟧: a perfect smile (figurative)

RELATED SCORING TERMS:
- ⟦{零点|れいてん}→零点：21414_reiten⟧/0⟦{点|てん}→点：01553_ten⟧: zero points
- ⟦{合格点|ごうかくてん}→合格点：25967_goukakuten⟧: passing score
- ⟦{平均点|へいきんてん}→平均点：21466_heikinten⟧: average score
- ⟦{最高点|さいこうてん}→最高点：25791_saikouten⟧: highest score
